name: Green Ladies

attributes.attribute: British fairy maidens who haunt fresh water
stay at wells, lakes, and pools
sometimes lure people to death like mermaids
French fairy figures of the same name

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Green Ladies are fairy figures from British folklore. Like the French Dames Vertes that bear the same name, these fairy maidens haunt fresh water. They keep to wells, lakes, and pools in Britain. Some of them draw people toward their death in the manner of mermaids, yet others show a merry and pleasing side.

okr.objective: Explain the British Green Ladies and their kinship with the French Dames Vertes.
key_results: Green Ladies haunt the wells, lakes, and pools of Britain.
They share a name with the Dames Vertes of France.
Some are deadly to people yet others stay merry.
